name: FileTrigger
summary: Opens a native file picker and reports selected files.

useWhen: Selecting one or more local files
avoidWhen: Receiving files by drag and drop

obligations: Expose a keyboard-operable file picker trigger.
Keep the native input hidden from the visual layout while retaining its native picker semantics.

behavior: Use the browser File API through RAC FileTrigger and report selected files as a Core File array.
Reset the native input before every press so selecting the same file again still emits select.
accessibility: Keep activation on the consumer trigger and preserve its accessible name.
Apply disabled behavior to the trigger while retaining the native input as a hidden implementation detail.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
